bridge-type.label: OCPP Server
bridge-type.description: OCPP 1.6-J central system endpoint. Chargers connect to ws://<host>:<port>/<chargePointId>.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Bind Address
parameter.description: Local address to bind the WebSocket server to.

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: TCP port the OCPP server listens on.

parameter.name: heartbeatInterval
parameter.label: Heartbeat Interval
parameter.description: Heartbeat interval returned to chargers in the BootNotification response.

parameter.name: meterValuesData
parameter.label: Meter Values Data
parameter.description: Comma-separated OCPP measurands to configure on chargers (MeterValuesSampledData/AlignedData). Empty leaves the charger unchanged.

parameter.name: meterValueSampleInterval
parameter.label: Meter Value Sample Interval
parameter.description: MeterValueSampleInterval to configure. -1 leaves the charger unchanged.

parameter.name: clockAlignedDataInterval
parameter.label: Clock Aligned Data Interval
parameter.description: ClockAlignedDataInterval to configure. -1 leaves the charger unchanged.

parameter.name: disableRemoteTxAuthorization
parameter.label: Disable Remote Tx Authorization
parameter.description: Configure chargers with AuthorizeRemoteTxRequests=false so a RemoteStart needs no extra Authorize.

parameter.name: vendorConfig
parameter.label: Vendor Configuration
parameter.description: Extra ChangeConfiguration entries as key=value, applied on boot.

parameter.name: pingInterval
parameter.label: Ping Interval
parameter.description: Seconds between server-driven WebSocket pings. A connection that does not answer with a pong within the interval is CLOSED — many chargers never answer pings, so leave this at 0 (disabled) unless you know yours does. Liveness is tracked via OCPP heartbeats regardless.

parameter.name: requestTimeoutSeconds
parameter.label: Request Timeout
parameter.description: Seconds before an unanswered request to a charger fails. The OCPP library itself never times a request out, so this bound is what keeps callers from waiting forever.

parameter.name: authPassword
parameter.label: Charger Password
parameter.description: HTTP Basic authentication password chargers must present, with their charge point id as the username (OCPP security profile 1). Must be 16–20 visible ASCII characters — the OCPP library rejects other lengths before authentication even runs. Empty disables authentication — profile 0, for a trusted LAN only.

parameter.name: tlsKeystore
parameter.label: TLS Keystore
parameter.description: Path to a PKCS12 keystore holding the server's TLS certificate and key. When set, the OCPP endpoint runs over wss:// (TLS) instead of ws:// — OCPP security profile 2 with a Charger Password, or an encrypted profile 0 without. Empty leaves the endpoint plain.

parameter.name: tlsKeystorePassword
parameter.label: TLS Keystore Password
parameter.description: Password for the TLS keystore (store and key password).

parameter.name: tags
parameter.label: Authorized Tags
parameter.description: idTag whitelist. Empty accepts every tag; otherwise unknown tags are rejected.

parameter.name: chargers
parameter.label: Permitted Chargers
parameter.description: Charge point id allow-list. Empty accepts any charger; otherwise unlisted chargers are rejected and closed.

bridge-type.label: OCPP Charge Point
bridge-type.description: A single charger identified by its OCPP charge point id.

parameter.name: chargePointId
parameter.label: Charge Point Id
parameter.description: The charger's OCPP identity — the path of the WebSocket URL it dials, without the leading slash (e.g. charger, or site/charger).

parameter.name: configSettleSeconds
parameter.label: Config Settle Seconds
parameter.description: Delay after BootNotification before sending the configuration burst. Some chargers are not ready to answer ChangeConfiguration immediately.

parameter.name: meterless
parameter.label: Meter-less Charger
parameter.description: The charger has no internal meter; only the periodic clock-aligned emission is disabled and meter measurand configuration is skipped.

parameter.name: heartbeat
parameter.label: Heartbeat Interval
parameter.description: Per-charger heartbeat interval returned on boot, overriding the server default. Also sizes the liveness window. 0 uses the server default.

thing-type.label: OCPP Connector
thing-type.description: A single connector (outlet) of a charger.

parameter.name: connectorId
parameter.label: Connector Id
parameter.description: OCPP connector number (1..N).

parameter.name: forceTxDefaultProfile
parameter.label: Force TxDefaultProfile
parameter.description: Always send a TxDefaultProfile for the charge limit, even during a transaction. Needed for chargers that reject a TxProfile outside a transaction (e.g. Phoenix CHARX).

parameter.name: profileMinIntervalMs
parameter.label: Charging Profile Min Interval
parameter.description: Minimum spacing between SetChargingProfile sends. Rapid changes are coalesced. 0 disables.

parameter.name: hardwareMaxCurrentKey
parameter.label: Hardware Max Current Key
parameter.description: Vendor ChangeConfiguration key backing the hardware maximum current channel. Empty disables that channel.

parameter.name: remoteStartTag
parameter.label: Remote Start Tag
parameter.description: idTag used when starting a transaction via the charging channel.

parameter.name: meterValuesPollSeconds
parameter.label: Meter Values Poll Interval
parameter.description: Poll this connector for MeterValues every N seconds via TriggerMessage. 0 disables polling.

parameter.name: stuckStateRecovery
parameter.label: Stuck State Recovery
parameter.description: Send an UnlockConnector if the connector stays in a transient state (Preparing/Finishing) too long. Off by default: those are normal states and unlocking is a physical side effect, so enable it only for a charger known to wedge there.

channel-type.label: Connected
channel-type.description: Whether the charger currently has an open session.

channel-type.label: Last Seen
channel-type.description: Timestamp of the last contact from the charger (a message, or the session opening).

channel-type.label: Status
channel-type.description: OCPP connector status (Available, Preparing, Charging, SuspendedEV, ...).

channel-type.label: Cable Connected
channel-type.description: Whether a vehicle cable is plugged in.

channel-type.label: Charging Session
channel-type.description: ON while a transaction is active; command to start/stop remotely.

channel-type.label: Charge Current Limit
channel-type.description: Maximum charging current applied via SetChargingProfile.

channel-type.label: Pause
channel-type.description: Pause charging (charging profile limit 0) without ending the transaction.

channel-type.label: Reset
channel-type.description: Momentary — soft reset the charge point (Reset).

channel-type.label: Hardware Max Current
channel-type.description: Charger hardware current ceiling, written via a vendor ChangeConfiguration key.

channel-type.label: Current
channel-type.description: Imported current on one phase (MeterValues Current.Import).

channel-type.label: Current Offered
channel-type.description: Current offered to the vehicle (MeterValues Current.Offered).

channel-type.label: Power Offered
channel-type.description: Power offered to the vehicle (MeterValues Power.Offered).

channel-type.label: Id Tag
channel-type.description: The idTag of the active transaction.
